tasks.title: Define client interfaces and canonical domain models
steps: Write unit tests TS-01-1, TS-01-2, TS-01-5, TS-01-6 and property tests TS-01-3, TS-01-4 in issuex/client_test.go and issuex/types_test.go; verify they fail.
In issuex/client.go, declare Client interface and ForgeClient type alias with context-first repository, issue, pull request, and lifecycle methods (Authenticated, Close).
In issuex/types.go, define Repo struct with Owner, Name, Host fields, implementing Valid() bool (requiring non-empty Owner and Name) and String() string returning "Owner/Name".
In issuex/types.go, define IssueRef with Repo, Number, IsPullRequest fields, implementing String() returning "owner/repo#number" and URL() returning canonical web URL.
In issuex/types.go, define Issue, IssueThread (with CommentsErr error tracking), Comment, User, PullRequest, ChangedFile, PRState, CheckRun, Review, Repository, RepoPermissions, and Label structs.

In issuex/types.go, define operation request parameter structs CreateIssueRequest, UpdateIssueRequest, CreatePullRequestRequest, IssueFilter, IssueList, CommentList, MergeOptions with MergeMethod enum constants, and MergeResult.
Run go test ./issuex/... to verify all types, methods, and property tests compile and pass.

tasks.title: Implement git remote, repository path, and issue URL parsing
steps: Write tests TS-01-7 through TS-01-13 covering ParseRepo, ParseRemote, DetectRepo, and ParseIssueURL in issuex/parse_test.go; verify they fail.

Implement ParseRepo(s string) (Repo, bool) to parse slash-delimited paths into Repo where Name is the last segment and Owner is preceding segments joined by slash, returning (Repo{}, false) for empty or slash-less input.
Implement ParseRemote(remote string) (Repo, bool) supporting HTTPS, SSH, and SCP syntax with multi-segment GitLab owners, stripping .git suffix and returning (Repo{}, false) on malformed URLs.

Implement DetectRepo(dir string) (Repo, bool) executing `git -C <dir> remote get-url origin` via os/exec, feeding stdout to ParseRemote, and returning (Repo{}, false) without error on command failure.

Implement ParseIssueURL(s string) (IssueRef, bool) parsing GitHub issues (/issues/{id}) and PRs (/pull/{id}), and GitLab issues (/-/issues/{id}) and MRs (/-/merge_requests/{id}) into IssueRef with IsPullRequest populated, rejecting invalid paths with (IssueRef{}, false).
Run go test ./issuex/... to verify all parsing and detection tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement standardized error hierarchy and rate-limit calculation
steps: Write unit tests TS-01-20, TS-01-21, and TS-01-22 in issuex/errors_test.go covering sentinel errors, HTTPError formatting, RetryAfter calculation, and error classifiers; verify they fail.
Define sentinel errors ErrNoToken, ErrNotFound, ErrConflict, ErrRateLimited, ErrUnsupportedForge, and ErrAmbiguousForge in issuex/errors.go.
Implement HTTPError struct storing Method, Path, Status, Message, RetryAfterHeader, RateLimitReset, and RateLimitRemaining, with Error() returning "<Method> <Path>: <Status> <Message>".

Implement (*HTTPError).RetryAfter() (time.Duration, bool) parsing numeric seconds from RetryAfterHeader or epoch seconds from RateLimitReset on HTTP 429 or 403 (with RateLimitRemaining == "0"), adding a 1-second buffer and returning (0, false) otherwise.
Implement error inspection helpers IsNotFound(err), IsConflict(err), IsRateLimited(err), and IsNoToken(err) using errors.Is and errors.As to inspect sentinels and HTTPError status codes.
Run go test ./issuex/... to verify all error definitions and inspection functions pass.

tasks.title: Implement shared transport safety utilities and retry backoff
steps: Write unit tests TS-01-23 through TS-01-26 in issuex/transport_test.go covering body size limits, rate-limit retries, 120-second backoff ceilings, unauthenticated 404 annotations, and custom sleep functions; verify they fail.
Implement response body reading utility wrapping response streams in io.LimitReader capped at 8 MB (8388608 bytes) to guard against unbounded memory allocation.
Implement transport execution helper with configurable sleep func(time.Duration) defaulting to time.Sleep.

Implement rate-limit backoff handler that inspects HTTP 429/403 responses via RetryAfter(): if backoff <= 120 seconds, sleep and retry the HTTP request once; if > 120 seconds, immediately return an error wrapping ErrRateLimited without retrying.

Implement response error handler that wraps HTTP 404 responses on unauthenticated clients (Authenticated() == false) with an explanatory message indicating the resource may be private and require authentication.
Run go test ./issuex/... to verify all transport safety and retry behaviors pass.

tasks.title: Implement NoOpClient for offline and forge-disabled operations
steps: Write unit tests TS-01-27, TS-01-28, and TS-01-29 in issuex/noop_test.go checking NoOpClient lifecycle, issue reads/writes, and PR operation rejections; verify they fail.
Implement NewNoOp() Client returning a NoOpClient struct satisfying the Client interface.
Implement Authenticated() returning false, Close() returning nil, and GetRepository() returning zero Repository and nil.
Implement issue read methods (ReadIssue, ListIssues, ListComments) returning zero-value structs and nil.
Implement issue write methods (CreateIssue, UpdateIssue, CloseIssue, AddComment, AddLabels, RemoveLabel, CreateLabel) returning zero values and nil without remote side effects.

Implement pull request methods (CreatePullRequest, ReadPullRequest, ReadChangedFiles, GetPRState, GetCIChecks, GetPRReviews, PostReviewComment, MergePullRequest, ClosePullRequest) returning non-nil errors containing "pull request operations require an active forge client".
Run go test ./issuex/... to verify NoOpClient satisfies Client and passes all test assertions.

tasks.title: Implement forge type detection and client options configuration
steps: Write tests TS-01-14 through TS-01-19 in issuex/options_test.go covering NoOp option dispatch, BaseURL detection, environment variable precedence, git origin fallback, ErrAmbiguousForge, and ErrUnsupportedForge; verify they fail.
Define Options struct with BaseURL, Token, HTTPClient (*http.Client), UserAgent, and NoOp fields, applying default timeout of 30 seconds and default UserAgent "agent-fox".
Define ForgeType enum constants (ForgeTypeGitHub, ForgeTypeGitLab).
In NewWithOptions(o Options) (Client, error), return NewNoOp() immediately if o.NoOp is true.
Implement BaseURL forge detection matching "github" / "api.github.com" to ForgeTypeGitHub and "gitlab" to ForgeTypeGitLab.

When BaseURL is empty, inspect GITHUB_API_URL, GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN vs GITLAB_API_URL, GITLAB_TOKEN, resolving default endpoints (https://api.github.com, https://gitlab.com/api/v4) and credentials when unambiguous.
When environment variables are both present or both absent, invoke DetectRepo(".") to detect forge from git origin remote host; return an error wrapping ErrAmbiguousForge if still unresolved.
For resolved ForgeTypeGitHub and ForgeTypeGitLab prior to adapter registration in issuex_core, return nil and an error wrapping ErrUnsupportedForge indicating the provider adapter is not registered.
Add New(userAgent string) (Client, error) shorthand calling NewWithOptions with default options.
Run go test ./issuex/... to verify options configuration and detection logic pass.

tasks.title: Verify end-to-end execution paths and production wiring
steps: Implement smoke test TS-01-30 in issuex/smoke_test.go verifying execution path 01-PATH-1 (NewWithOptions with NoOp: true, Authenticated() check, silent CreateIssue execution).
Implement smoke test TS-01-31 in issuex/smoke_test.go verifying execution path 01-PATH-2 (ParseRemote with git remote URLs, ParseIssueURL with web URLs, String() and URL() formatting).

Implement smoke test TS-01-32 in issuex/smoke_test.go verifying execution path 01-PATH-3 (HTTPError response creation, IsRateLimited classification, RetryAfter backoff duration calculation with buffer).
Trace execution paths 01-PATH-1, 01-PATH-2, and 01-PATH-3 through production code in issuex/; confirm each step calls the next and no stub remains.

For every criterion with a contract (01-REQ-3.2, 01-REQ-3.4, 01-REQ-3.6, 01-REQ-3.8, 01-REQ-4.7, 01-REQ-4.8, 01-REQ-5.4, 01-REQ-6.3, 01-REQ-6.4, 01-REQ-7.6), confirm the contract result is produced and handled properly in production code.
Search all files under issuex/ for stub markers (panic("not implemented"), TODO, NotImplementedError, bare return nil on non-trivial paths) and verify none remain.
Confirm that issuex package entry points are callable from external packages without import cycle or internal visibility restrictions.
Run `make check` (gofmt, go vet, and all tests) to verify clean repository state.
done_when: `make check` passes with all tests and linters clean
